blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of wine tastings including standard, icewine, sit-down, and flights paired with bites. Private tours and tastings with the owner or a tasting room representative provide insights into organic winemaking and vineyard processes. The winery is located in the Okanagan Valley and features organic estate vineyards with views of the lake and mountains.
